items.title: The Agent controls Whytap
items.body: Ask it to change a model, switch Drop mode or set a hotkey, and it does it in one turn.

items.title: Answers you can insert
items.body: A rewrite, translation or command comes back as a card that pastes into the field you came from.

items.title: Calendar is open
items.body: Your Mac's calendars in the island: Google, Outlook, Exchange and iCloud.

items.title: Models in two picks
items.body: One Speech row and one LLM row set every feature at once. A model per feature stays under Advanced.

items.title: Subtitles show both languages
items.body: Each phrase is a pair: the original beside its translation.
